pageCache.pageTitle: Ethos and Opossum Values | Dawlish Primary School
pageCache.text:
Ethos and Opossum Values
Unleashing Possibilities
We believe that all pupils deserve high quality education which engages, inspires and challenges, so that everyone meets their full potential. We strive to create a safe and happy learning environment which promotes independence and high expectations of all. We are committed to providing opportunities which promote open-mindedness, empathy and celebration of the rich and diverse community we serve so that everyone is able to contribute positively to society. We are dedicated to promoting healthy lifestyle choices so that our pupils develop physically, emotionally and morally. We are determined that our pupils will be successful and leave us as confident, highly educated members of the community. We do this by
The Opossum Federation community has identified the following values which guide our work. We expect that all members of our community agree to demonstrate these values.
To help protect our rights and to encourage responsibility, we have Golden Expectations for our school which demonstrate our core values
Being RESPECTFUL We are considerate of our own actions and words and of how we treat others and our environment Being ASPIRATIONAL We are bold in what we believe our schools and those who are a part of Opossum can achieve Being CARING We show kindness and concern for self and others Having INTEGRITY We always do the right thing in the right way Being CREATIVE We like to use original and imaginative ideas Being COMMUNITY MINDED We are socially concerned and believe in supporting the wider Opossum community
British Values Statement
We value the diverse backgrounds of all pupils, families and the wider school community. Our schools reflect British Values in all that we do. We aim to prepare the children to make a positive contribution to British society and the world. Through the curriculum we focus on global citizenship and strong personal values. We nurture independent learning skills, encouraging every student to take responsibility for themselves and their learning.
We actively promote British Values in the following ways:
Tolerance of those with Different Faiths and Beliefs
Ethos and Opossum Values
Expectations are clear, fair and regularly promoted

Welcome
Welcome to the Dawlish Primary School website. We hope that you will find this website helpful in keeping members of our school community informed about important information, learning and events at our school.
We are a vibrant and forward thinking community with proud and enthusiastic pupils who want to achieve the best. Our dedicated staff team works hard to create an exciting learning environment, tailored to each and every child, providing the opportunity to achieve their full potential.
We serve a supportive and welcoming community. We aim to continue our strong relationship with parents/carers, as this partnership is important in helping our pupils to achieve the greatest success.

Morning Session – from 7:30am.
Provision of a light and healthy breakfast to start the day Afternoon Session – until 6:00pm,
with a light snack and a variety of fun, enriching activities
Whether you're looking for early drop-off, late pick-up, or both, the Dawlish Breakfast and Tea Time Club is here to help make school days easier for everyone.
We look forward to welcoming your children to this exciting new part of school life!

PE Premium
This report examines the effectiveness of PE provision and the impact of the PE Premium. Since 2013, the government has provided additional funding with the key aim of improving the provision of active healthy lifestyle learning in primary schools. This funding – provided jointly by the Departments for Education, Health and Culture, Media and Sport – is allocated to primary schools across the country. The money is ring fenced and must be used to improve the application of PE and school sport within both curricular and extra-curricular environments. This report outlines PE provision across the federation and the impact of the funding.
PE Premium
